title: Parcel delivery fee
plain_description: A message says a parcel is held and asks for card details or a link.
scammer_goal: Get card details through a fake fee link.
opening_message: Parcel Express UK: Your parcel is held. Pay a small fee at [fake link] or it will be returned.

easy.opening_message: Pay £2.99 now at [fake link] or your Parcel Express UK package is destroyed today.

hard.opening_message: Hello. Parcel Express UK tried to deliver today. Please confirm a small customs fee using our secure page: [fake link].
